primary: ΔR = Δ mean|ΔNormalScore_z|（vs 同 (cat,seed) corrected Original）

advance_rule.R1: Pareto-positive（一侧改善且另一侧基本不退）或明显减少 catastrophic；纯 trade-off 不算晋级；最多 Top3
advance_rule.R2: +screw/grid → 需 ≥4/5 PASS 且无新增 catastrophic；最多 Top2

parameter_sensitivity.note: §17：winner 已来自该 grid → 禁止细化（0.45/0.48…）；§18：输出 coarse sensitivity curve，尖锐孤立峰 => HIGH OVERFITTING RISK

auto_stop.S1: 出现 ≥13/15 + 0 catastrophic 且参数稳定 => 转 stability validation
auto_stop.S2: 所有候选均不超过 B2 => STOP METHOD SEARCH
auto_stop.S3: 性能并列 => 取更简单者
